quote: As usual with Martin's sessions, he really makes ideas and points very clear. The opportunity to practice really instills confidence in being able to use the suggestions straight away in real life presentation situations. Always grateful for all his tips and ability to keep the session engaging. The 1.5 hours flew away (as he said at the beginning of the session). Thank you, Martin (or Mark as you were known by your music teacher for several years! Always good to throw in stories as you said!).
author: Ko
subject: Presentation Skills
